title: Joom Ɗaɓɓuɗo Alla
intro: Laamɗo baawɗo mawninkiniiɗo ina goongɗini hay gooto daraaki dow jappeere maɓɓe. Ɓe ndogi fedde dogooɓe e nder ndiyam mawɗam, haa ɓe kawri e joofnirde teskinnde. Daartol ngol joom mum ina 6eydoo 6ooyde e binndancfe keewcfe e nder Qur’aana, ina wona jeertinaango wonande yim6e fof.
clues: Miin ko mi laamɗo doole, miɗo sikki hay laamu gooto ɓuraani laamu am e nder leyɗeele ɗe laamnoo-mi.
Miɗo joginoo wasiir gooto koolaaɗo ina wiyee Haman, ballitooɗo mi e waɗde eɓɓooji mahdi mawɗi.
Mi noddii maagiyaŋkooɓe ɓurɓe moƴƴude e leydi am ngam luulndaade maandeeji nulaaɗo luutndiiɗo mi.
Mi salii yo leñol maccuɓe e nder laamu am ngol yaltu, hay so tawii ko ñawuuji e jeertinaali laaɓtuɗi.
Mi riwi ɓe haa maayo mawngo, mi wondi e konu am fuu e pucci am fuu.
Ndeen geec tigi udditi mi e doole am, ina 6uu6na min fof, tawi 6e taccii e jam.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Mahngo laana ko adii ilam mawɗam
Hare e Jalut e nder falnde

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Hisnaama e yurmeende Allah e muñal njoɓaa
Jokkondirde e ɓesngu caggal duuɓi caɗeele

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
